offering_description.value: Designs, markets and sells footwear, apparel and accessories under brands such as UGG and HOKA, plus Teva and others. Products are made by third-party contract manufacturers and sold to consumers through wholesale partners, own stores and e-commerce.

primary_products.value: casual and sheepskin footwear; performance running and trail footwear; sandals; apparel and accessories

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying footwear and apparel via own stores and websites; B2B: wholesale retailers, department stores, specialty and sporting goods stores, international distributors

end_markets.value: footwear; fashion apparel; running and outdoor athletics; consumer retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: footwear and apparel sold wholesale to retailers and distributors, and direct to consumers through own stores and e-commerce

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded footwear made by contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates own retail stores and e-commerce sites selling its brands to consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia Pacific, and other international markets via distributors

specialization.value: related lines: footwear brands (UGG, HOKA, Teva and others) with related apparel and accessories

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: department stores, specialty footwear and sporting goods retailers; own locations: company-operated brand retail stores and outlets; online: brand e-commerce websites; distributors / dealers: international distributors in markets without direct operations
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; own locations; online; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: import tariffs and customs rules, product safety and chemical rules, labor standards in sourcing, data privacy laws
